messages_body:
Hi Marissa,

Quick intro — Monarch Analytics (cc'd: Alex Hernandez) is evaluating inference platforms for a recommendation engine PoC. We think Redwood would be a great fit and recommended we connect for a short demo. Alex is based in PST.

Could you share 30–45 min availability next week? TechSys can help with intro context.

Thanks,
Jen Carter
Partner Lead, TechSys
jen.carter@techsys.com

Hi Jen — thanks for the intro and hi Alex — great to meet you.

We'd love to demo Redwood and walk through typical latency/cost tradeoffs for a recommendation workload. I can do 30 mins on Monday 8/24 or Tuesday 8/25 between 9am–2pm PT.

Looping in Camila (SDR) to lock a time and Alex Martinez (SE) to cover the technical deep-dive.

I've attached a short demo deck and a calendar placeholder. If either of those times don't work, send a couple windows and we'll accommodate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (PDF, 4MB)]

Hi Alex / Marissa — Camila here.

Thanks for the intro. A few options that work for the team:
- Mon 8/24: 9:30am, 11:00am PT
- Tue 8/25: 10:00am, 1:30pm PT

Please reply with the slot that works best and I'll send the calendar invite.

If none of those fit, share a couple preferred windows and I'll coordinate.

Thanks!
Camila Reyes
SDR, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-demo-invite.ics]

Thanks Jen/Marissa/Camila — appreciate the quick turnaround. I can do Tue 8/25 but need to move to the afternoon due to an exec sync. Would 2:00pm PT on Tue 8/25 work? If not, we can do Mon 8/24 at 11:00am.

On Tue's agenda I'd like to see:
- live demo of inference latency on recommendation model
- discussion of deployment options (hosted vs dedicated)
- guidance on cost optimization (batching/quantization)

Looking forward — Alex
Alex Hernandez
Head of ML Engineering, Monarch Analytics
alex.hernandez@monarch.ai

Alex — 2:00pm PT on Tue 8/25 works for us. Thanks for the agenda — we'll prepare a short PoC checklist and some examples specific to recommendation workloads.

Alex Martinez (cc) will run the technical portion and cover model compatibility and deployment options. Camila — can you send a calendar invite for Tue 8/25 2:00pm PT and include the preliminary agenda: intro (5), demo (20), Q&A/next steps (5)?

Jen — thanks again for the referral.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — I'll lead the demo and focus the technical portion on the items Marissa listed. I'll cover:
- model architecture assumptions and sizing
- expected latency for 512-token recommendation payloads on hosted vs dedicated
- KV cache and batching recommendations to hit sub-100ms tail latency
- next steps for a short pilot (data needs, timeline)

I'll be ready at 2:00pm PT on Tue 8/25.

— Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai
